reduce.name: progress deltas accumulate into one live bubble
text payload replaces, delta appends
reset drops streamed text and keeps waiting tools
tool call flushes the sentence and becomes a step
ask_user never joins the live step line
activity progress keeps its flag and replaces narration
shown flag survives on the growing tail
message.created replaces the live bubble and upserts by id
user echo keeps author and its own seq
update keeps the known callId and createdAt
duplicate and out-of-order seq are dropped
unknown event types leave the snapshot unchanged
event without seq keeps the cursor
run.started builds the running record and activeRuns
send receipt then started then progress then completed
run.failed keeps the clamped error in run
run.failed without a usable error clears the primary run
run.cancelled drops the live bubble and the run
background ticket run stays invisible
second run keeps the waiting card answerable
waiting_input settles a known run and drops its progress
waiting_input inserts an unknown peer run
waiting_input on a helper run does not promote over a waiting card
takeover requested then released
takeover release leaves a non-waiting run alone
group failure banner survives a late member start
member run failure is found in activeRuns
terminal event drops the run's live progress bubble
thread.cleared empties the transcript and runs
member status follows run lifecycle in a group
subagent rows order before the streamed answer and settle on pause
running subagent settles to stopped when its run ends
saved subagent card replaces the live placeholder
cloud agent card updates in place
answered helper card ends the chat waiting state
reply metadata is kept across updates that omit it
fallback failure envelope clamps each model diagnostic
started keeps the previous userId and routine fields

receipt.name: receipt shows the queued run at once
receipt createdAt is carried into the queued run
a queue-holding run refuses the receipt
a waiting card holds no compute; the receipt queues behind it
a terminal run never shows as queued again
a group thread takes no direct receipt

refresh.name: older refresh cannot roll the live cursor back
older refresh hydrates the matching live run after optimistic stop
older refresh without matching progress keeps prev whole
equal-cursor refresh keeps the event-sourced waiting_takeover
preserveLoadedHistory keeps older pages under the recent one
without preserveLoadedHistory the recent page stands alone

merge.name: merge keeps prev when its cursor is ahead
merge takes next at equal cursor
merge with null prev takes next

terminal.name: the memory caps at 100 runs, oldest first

blocks.name: empty text update produces no tail
pending tool waits for the sentence end
reset re-appends waiting tools as steps
